Get Turbo colormap

Source: R/turbo.R
turbo.Rd

Get Turbo colormap

Usage

turbo(n)

Arguments

n

integer, amount of colors

Value

vector of Turbo hexcode colors

Examples

colorify(colors=colorify:::turbo(100), plot = TRUE)
